Radiosowjo
Radiosowjo is a temporary radio station, which students of the department of
visual communication of the Kunsthochschule Weißensee in the context of a study
trip to Sauen for four days.
Every day in the evening we released a previously produced radio program,
consisting of six broadcasts. It was broadcasted via the website weissensee.blog.
Daily tuning-in in the former Ice-Depot at the Gutshof Sauen. The Round arch produced excellent acoustics.

Education: Seminars: The Invisible Cities
The Invisible Cities
“The Invisible Cities” by Italo Calvino is a mosaic of 55 portraits of cities that
Marco Polo reported to the Chinese emperor Kublai Khan. The portraits are
wonderful poetic symbols of the paradoxes of human existence. Based on selected
cities of the book, full-spherical 360° illustrations for mobile phones and tablet
computers are to be developed, which interpret and narrate the respective city with
animations, minimal interaction and sound in a playful and exciting way. The plan
is to publish a digital publication of the results. We will accompany each project
creatively and technically and provide ready-made solutions that answer the
programming questions as far as possible. We will work in Unity.
